common.loadErrorBody: Check your internet connection and try again. The results are saved and nothing is lost.
common.nextNone: No more waves are scheduled this season.

empty34.title: No measurements yet
empty34.body: The report appears here once {name} has taken a wave and it has been measured. A wave can be taken at home or at a tutor’s.

tiles.title: Where {name} is
tiles.body: The place among children of the same grade and region, shown as a range.

tiles.title: Where {name} is heading
tiles.body: How that range moves from one wave to the next.

tiles.title: What to do
tiles.body: One concrete action with a clear time budget.

empty02.title: {name} hasn’t been measured yet
empty02.body: After the first wave you’ll see which skills are secure, which are emerging, and one thing to do at home. Instructions are read aloud, so {name} doesn’t need to read.

tiles.title: Secure
tiles.body: Several right answers in one wave, confirmed again in the next.

tiles.title: Emerging
tiles.body: Sometimes right, not steady yet. This is where help at home pays off most.

tiles.title: Not yet
tiles.body: Too early to work on. This skill comes in its own time.

empty02.note: There will be no comparison with other children, only what {name} can do.

hero.sub: among {n} grade-{g} children in {region} who took wave {w}.
hero.scaleAria: Top {from}–{to}% on a scale from the strongest children to the top {max}%. The stage 2 zone is around the top 5%.
hero.rangeNote: A range, not a single number: any 30-question test carries some error. To reach stage 2 of the olympiad a child needs to be around the top 5%.
hero.belowTitle: Not enough children in this cohort yet
hero.belowBody: So far {n} of the {min} children needed in {name}’s cohort (grade {g}, {region}) have been measured. With fewer, a range would mislead, so we don’t show one yet.
hero.noBandBody: A range for this wave isn’t available yet. It appears once enough children in the cohort have been measured.

trend.hint: Choose a column to read the note for that wave.

notes.first: The starting point. Every later wave is compared with this one.
notes.steady: This range overlaps the one before, so treat it as steady rather than a jump.
notes.up: A clear move up: the whole range sits above the one before.
notes.down: Lower than the wave before: the whole range sits below the previous one. One wave is not a verdict, and the next one shows whether it holds.
notes.below: Too few children in the cohort that wave to show a range.
notes.notTaken: Not taken. A skipped wave stays a gap in the chart, never a zero.
notes.awaiting: Taken. The range appears once the wave closes and is measured.
notes.open: Open now, until {date}. This is the wave that shows whether the plan below is working.
notes.upcoming: Not open yet. Wave {n} opens on {date}.

trend.hintBody: A skipped wave shows up as a gap in the chart, never as a zero.

g5.title: The “5” is needed. It measures something else.
g5.body: Top marks in school let {name} apply. They don’t show how {name} compares with the other children applying for each seat, and nearly all of them have top marks too. This report covers the part the school grade doesn’t.
g5.ticketDone: Ticket to the spring final earned: {taken} waves taken, {needed} were needed.
g5.ticketLeft: {taken} of {needed} waves taken: {left} more for the spring-final ticket.

hold.titleNone: No area stands apart from the overall result
hold.titleNoData: Areas aren’t broken down for this wave yet
hold.meta: Three areas, each compared with {name}’s own overall result

text.weaker: Below the overall result. This is where most points go.

hold.patternNote: This example is similar to the test questions, not taken from them.
hold.seasonEvery: Seen in every wave so far. This is not one bad day: it’s the thing most worth working on.
hold.seasonNone: Nothing repeats across the season so far.

act.titlePattern: Work on “{topic}”: 15 minutes, three times a week
act.titleRoutine: Keep a routine: 15 minutes, three times a week
act.bodyPattern: Talk through one problem of this kind together and ask {name} to explain each step. After every answer, ask one question:
act.bodyRoutine: Mixed problems from all three areas. After every answer, ask one question:
act.question: “Is that the number the question asks for?”
act.bodyEnd: The goal is the habit of checking, not speed.
act.note: To add something new, first finish this one.
act.noteDone: The next wave will show whether it helped.

planB.title: A good plan has a second option
planB.body: The Presidential School is one route among several. These are strong too:

access.title: Who can see {name}’s report
access.ownerLine: Full access. Grants and removes access for others.
access.coLine: Can view. Only the owner grants access.
access.noEducators: No tutor or teacher can see this report.
access.readOnly: Only the owner can change who sees the report.

practice.title: Practice
practice.note34: Practice builds skills and isn’t a measurement, so it has no effect on the position above.
practice.note02: Practice builds skills and isn’t a measurement, so it has no effect on the skill states above.

skills.barAria: Of {n} skills: {s} secure, {e} emerging, {ny} not yet, {u} not assessed yet.
skills.rule: A skill counts as secure only after several right answers in one wave, confirmed again in the next wave. One lucky answer doesn’t count.
skills.newNote: Each new skill was confirmed in two waves in a row.
skills.newNone: No skill has been confirmed as secure yet. That takes two waves in a row, so it shows up after the next one.
skills.listHint: Open a skill to see how we know.
skills.filterEmpty: No skills in this group right now.

ev.secure: Right several times in wave {a}, confirmed again in wave {w}.
ev.emerging: Sometimes right in wave {w}, not steady yet. The next wave checks again.
ev.not_yet: Came up in wave {w}, not solved yet. It comes in its own time, so it’s too early to push.
ev.none: Not assessed yet this season. It comes up in a later wave.

act02.title: {skill}: through play, 10 minutes at a time
act02.body: This skill is emerging, which is where effort pays off most. Not at a desk: make it part of an everyday moment, at the market, on a walk or while cooking. Stop while {name} still wants to keep going.
act02.note: More is not better at this age. Ten minutes is the whole plan, not the minimum.
act02.noneTitle: Keep the routine: 10 minutes of play at a time
act02.noneBody: No skill needs extra attention right now. Keep counting, sorting and talking through small everyday problems together, and stop while {name} still wants to keep going.

refusal.title: “What are the chances at the Presidential School?”
refusal.body: At this age any honest answer would be made up. Tests this early predict results at ten poorly: sleep, mood and even birth month play a part. We start showing a position among other children in grade 3, when the results start to mean something.
